hebrewText: ה֣וּא הֵסִ֣יר אֶת הַ/בָּמ֗וֹת וְ/שִׁבַּר֙ אֶת הַ/מַּצֵּבֹ֔ת וְ/כָרַ֖ת אֶת הָֽ/אֲשֵׁרָ֑ה וְ/כִתַּת֩ נְחַ֨שׁ הַ/נְּחֹ֜שֶׁת אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֣ה מֹשֶׁ֗ה כִּ֣י עַד הַ/יָּמִ֤ים הָ/הֵ֨מָּה֙ הָי֤וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מְקַטְּרִ֣ים ל֔/וֹ וַ/יִּקְרָא ל֖/וֹ נְחֻשְׁתָּֽן

tokens.bdb: he (she or it); only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also (intensively) self, or (especially with the article) the same; sometimes (as demonstrative) this or that; occasionally (instead of copula) as or are
tokens.kjv: he, as for her, him(-self), it, the same, she (herself), such, that (...it), these, they, this, those, which (is), who.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self
tokens.enLiteralWord: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self
tokens.explanation: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self
tokens.explanationEn: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self

tokens.bdb: to turn off (literal or figurative)
tokens.kjv: be(-head), bring, call back, decline, depart, eschew, get (you), go (aside), [idiom] grievous, lay away (by), leave undone, be past, pluck away, put (away, down), rebel, remove (to and fro), revolt, [idiom] be sour, take (away, off), turn (aside, away, in), withdraw, be without.
tokens.explanation: to turn off

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
tokens.kjv: (as such unrepresented in English).
tokens.explanation: et — partícula de objeto direto, sem tradução literal em português

tokens.bdb: an elevation
tokens.kjv: height, high place, wave.
tokens.explanation: an elevation

tokens.bdb: to burst (literally or figuratively)
tokens.kjv: break (down, off, in pieces, up), broken (-hearted), bring to the birth, crush, destroy, hurt, quench, [idiom] quite, tear, view (by mistake for H7663 (שָׂבַר)).
tokens.explanation: to burst

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
tokens.kjv: (as such unrepresented in English).
tokens.explanation: et — partícula de objeto direto, sem tradução literal em português

tokens.bdb: something stationed, i.e. a column or (memorial stone); by analogy, an idol
tokens.kjv: garrison, (standing) image, pillar.
tokens.explanation: something stationed

tokens.bdb: to cut (off, down or asunder); by implication, to destroy or consume; specifically, to covenant (i.e. make an alliance or bargain, originally by cutting flesh and passing between the pieces)
tokens.kjv: be chewed, be con-(feder-) ate, covenant, cut (down, off), destroy, fail, feller, be freed, hew (down), make a league (covenant), [idiom] lose, perish, [idiom] utterly, [idiom] want.
tokens.explanation: to cut (off

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
tokens.kjv: (as such unrepresented in English).

tokens.bdb: Asherah (or Astarte) a Phoenician goddess; also an image of the same
tokens.kjv: grove. Compare H6253 (עַשְׁתֹּרֶת).
tokens.ptLiteralWord: Asherah  a Phoenician goddess; also an image of the same
tokens.enLiteralWord: Asherah  a Phoenician goddess; also an image of the same
tokens.explanation: Asherah  a Phoenician goddess; also an image of the same
tokens.explanationEn: Asherah  a Phoenician goddess; also an image of the same

tokens.bdb: to bruise or violently strike
tokens.kjv: beat (down, to pieces), break in pieces, crushed, destroy, discomfit, smite, stamp. l
tokens.explanation: to bruise or violently strike

tokens.bdb: a snake (from its hiss)
tokens.kjv: serpent.
tokens.explanation: a snake

tokens.bdb: copper, hence, something made of that metal, i.e. coin, a fetter; figuratively, base (as compared with gold or silver)
tokens.kjv: brasen, brass, chain, copper, fetter (of brass), filthiness, steel.
tokens.explanation: copper

tokens.bdb: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
tokens.kjv: [idiom] after, [idiom] alike, as (soon as), because, [idiom] every, for, [phrase] forasmuch, [phrase] from whence, [phrase] how(-soever), [idiom] if, (so) that ((thing) which, wherein), [idiom] though, [phrase] until, [phrase] whatsoever, when, where ([phrase] -as, -in, -of, -on, -soever, -with), which, whilst, [phrase] whither(-soever), who(-m, -soever, -se). As it is indeclinable, it is often accompanied by the personal pronoun expletively, used to show the connection.
tokens.explanation: asher — pronome relativo: que, quem, o qual, cujo

tokens.bdb: to do or make, in the broadest sense and widest application
tokens.kjv: accomplish, advance, appoint, apt, be at, become, bear, bestow, bring forth, bruise, be busy, [idiom] certainly, have the charge of, commit, deal (with), deck, [phrase] displease, do, (ready) dress(-ed), (put in) execute(-ion), exercise, fashion, [phrase] feast, (fight-) ing man, [phrase] finish, fit, fly, follow, fulfill, furnish, gather, get, go about, govern, grant, great, [phrase] hinder, hold (a feast), [idiom] indeed, [phrase] be industrious, [phrase] journey, keep, labour, maintain, make, be meet, observe, be occupied, offer, [phrase] officer, pare, bring (come) to pass, perform, pracise, prepare, procure, provide, put, requite, [idiom] sacrifice, serve, set, shew, [idiom] sin, spend, [idiom] surely, take, [idiom] thoroughly, trim, [idiom] very, [phrase] vex, be (warr-) ior, work(-man), yield, use.
tokens.explanation: asah — fazer, realizar, executar, praticar, produzir

tokens.bdb: Mosheh, the Israelite lawgiver
tokens.kjv: Moses.
tokens.explanation: Moshe — Moisés, o grande legislador e profeta de Israel

tokens.bdb: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
tokens.kjv: and, + (forasmuch, inasmuch, where-) as, assured(-ly), + but, certainly, doubtless, + else, even, + except, for, how, (because, in, so, than) that, + nevertheless, now, rightly, seeing, since, surely, then, therefore, + (al-) though, + till, truly, + until, when, whether, while, whom, yea, yet.
tokens.enLiteralWord: very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb ; often largely modified by other particles annexed
tokens.explanation: ki — conjunção causal e explicativa: porque, pois, que, quando
tokens.explanationEn: very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb ; often largely modified by other particles annexed

tokens.bdb: as far (or long, or much) as, whether of space (even unto) or time (during, while, until) or degree (equally with)
tokens.kjv: against, and, as, at, before, by (that), even (to), for(-asmuch as), (hither-) to, [phrase] how long, into, as long (much) as, (so) that, till, toward, until, when, while, ([phrase] as) yet.
tokens.explanation: as far (or long

tokens.bdb: a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb)
tokens.kjv: age, [phrase] always, [phrase] chronicals, continually(-ance), daily, ((birth-), each, to) day, (now a, two) days (agone), [phrase] elder, [idiom] end, [phrase] evening, [phrase] (for) ever(-lasting, -more), [idiom] full, life, as (so) long as (... live), (even) now, [phrase] old, [phrase] outlived, [phrase] perpetually, presently, [phrase] remaineth, [idiom] required, season, [idiom] since, space, then, (process of) time, [phrase] as at other times, [phrase] in trouble, weather, (as) when, (a, the, within a) while (that), [idiom] whole ([phrase] age), (full) year(-ly), [phrase] younger.
tokens.explanation: yom — dia, período de luz, era, tempo específico

tokens.bdb: they (only used when emphatic)
tokens.kjv: it, like, [idiom] (how, so) many (soever, more as) they (be), (the) same, [idiom] so, [idiom] such, their, them, these, they, those, which, who, whom, withal, ye.
tokens.explanation: they

tokens.bdb: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
tokens.kjv: beacon, [idiom] altogether, be(-come), accomplished, committed, like), break, cause, come (to pass), do, faint, fall, [phrase] follow, happen, [idiom] have, last, pertain, quit (one-) self, require, [idiom] use.
tokens.explanation: hayah — ser, existir, acontecer, tornar-se

tokens.bdb: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
tokens.kjv: [phrase] afflicted, age, (Ahoh-) (Ammon-) (Hachmon-) (Lev-) ite, (anoint-) ed one, appointed to, ([phrase]) arrow, (Assyr-) (Babylon-) (Egypt-) (Grec-) ian, one born, bough, branch, breed, [phrase] (young) bullock, [phrase] (young) calf, [idiom] came up in, child, colt, [idiom] common, [idiom] corn, daughter, [idiom] of first, [phrase] firstborn, foal, [phrase] very fruitful, [phrase] postage, [idiom] in, [phrase] kid, [phrase] lamb, ([phrase]) man, meet, [phrase] mighty, [phrase] nephew, old, ([phrase]) people, [phrase] rebel, [phrase] robber, [idiom] servant born, [idiom] soldier, son, [phrase] spark, [phrase] steward, [phrase] stranger, [idiom] surely, them of, [phrase] tumultuous one, [phrase] valiant(-est), whelp, worthy, young (one), youth.
tokens.explanation: ben — filho, descendente, membro de um grupo (bar em aramaico)

tokens.bdb: Jisrael, a symbolical name of Jacob; also (typically) of his posterity
tokens.kjv: Israel.
tokens.explanation: Yisrael — nome dado a Jacó (aquele que luta com Deus)

tokens.bdb: to smoke, i.e. turn into fragrance by fire (especially as an act of worship)
tokens.kjv: burn (incense, sacrifice) (upon), (altar for) incense, kindle, offer (incense, a sacrifice).
tokens.explanation: to smoke

tokens.bdb: to call out to (i.e. properly, address by name, but used in a wide variety of applications)
tokens.kjv: bewray (self), that are bidden, call (for, forth, self, upon), cry (unto), (be) famous, guest, invite, mention, (give) name, preach, (make) proclaim(-ation), pronounce, publish, read, renowned, say.
tokens.explanation: qara — chamar, nomear, convocar, proclamar, invocar

tokens.bdb: something made of copper, i.e. the copper serpent of the Desert
tokens.kjv: Nehushtan.
tokens.explanation: something made of copper
